messages:
Ivy: tiny life update  got promoted to Staff SWE this week! :tada: low-key planning a small potluck tomorrow at 4pm in the kitchen if folks want to swing by for 15 mins. totally optional.
Diego: YASSSS IVY!!! huge congrats :raised_hands: ill bring empanadas (nut-free).
Sasha: omg congrats!!! cake? i can pick up a dairy-free option.
Priya: congrats ivy :confetti_ball: ill bring a salad (labelled GF).
Ben: huge congrats, well deserved. can help with setup + cleanup at 3:45.
Ivy: thank you all  keeping it short so folks can get back to heads-down. please label allergens.
People Ops: congrats Ivy! if you want a group card we can circulate a digital one. reminder: no unsupervised pets in common areas; please tidy after.
Sasha: what time should i drop cake off?
Ivy: cake drop by 3:50 is perfect.
Diego: sending confetti GIF :confetti_ball: see you tomorrow.
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Ivy  Staff SWE potluck" Thu Sep 23 16:00-16:20 (Conference Kitchen). Invite sent to #all.
Ivy: seriously grateful  thank you everyone. DM me if you want to add a short note for the card. :heart:
